params.prompt:
ONE UNBROKEN CONTINUOUS SHOT, first frame to last: a single take with no cuts. One smooth gimbal camera keeps the airplane in view. Photorealistic live action, 16:9.
The airplane is the plain white dart from the airplane reference: crisply, completely folded from blank A4 (no print, no logo), long sharp nose, two flat identical swept-back wings, sharp creases, neat keel, never crumpled or half-folded. It flies nose first on one smooth continuous path, never jumps, flips or reverses, turns only in slow gentle curves, and never changes shape or size.
Sunny late morning, same warm sunlight direction throughout, no flicker.
Festival ground = the two festival references, identical layout: a natural green GRASS soccer pitch with striped mowing and white lines inside a red running track; at the FAR end the festival stage with a white truss roof and white tents on both sides; four blocks of black chairs in front of the stage; a small black sound booth in the centre circle; long rows of white booth tents along both sides of the track; the green inflatable air arch standing at the track gate on the NEAR curve, not on the grass; outside the track, nearest the school, the paved lot with six colourful food trucks, white tents and yellow parasol tables; a bus and trucks on the road; red, green and orange bean bags on the lawn to the right; green trees and apartment blocks behind. The festival is busy and joyful: hundreds of students fill the ground, browsing and chatting at the booth tents, queuing and eating at the food trucks and parasol tables, lounging and laughing on the bean bags, posing for photos at the air arch, sitting together in the chair blocks and walking around in small groups; always small, seen from above or behind, no recognisable faces.
Clear deep blue sky above the same school.
Continue the reference video seamlessly from its very last frame as the SAME continuous shot: the first frame keeps the same camera position, the same airplane position and heading, the same location and the same light as the last frame of the reference video.
START STATE: About five metres up at the far end of the grass pitch, seen from just behind, the white airplane glides to the right over the crowded black chair blocks in front of the stage, toward the row of white booth tents on the right long side of the red track.
The whole flight below is ONE unbroken take in this exact order, with natural, unhurried pacing and no fixed timing; each stage flows smoothly into the next with no cut:
1. Continuing the reference video without any cut, at the same low height, the airplane finishes its slow curve around the far end and flies back along the RIGHT long side of the red track over the row of white booth tents full of students, toward the school, gradually lowering to just above head height. The camera stays about two metres behind it.
2. At the near end it curves gently left over the road to the busy food-truck lot: students queuing at the six colourful trucks and eating at the yellow parasol tables, seen from above and behind.
3. It curves right and glides along the road and over the lawn with red, green and orange bean bags where groups of students lounge, chat and laugh.
4. It turns smoothly toward the green inflatable air arch at the track gate, where students pose for photos, and flies straight through the middle of the arch; the camera passes through right behind it.
5. Inside the track it glides low across the grass pitch, past the sound booth, just above the heads of the many students sitting together in the black chair blocks, heading straight for the stage.
6. Only now does it rise: the airplane climbs smoothly over the white truss roof of the stage and keeps climbing straight up into the deep blue sky; the camera tilts up following it, the frame fills with sky and sunlight and glows to pure white.
FINAL FRAME: The frame is entirely bright white light.
Audio: diegetic only: lively festival ambience (many voices chatting, gentle laughter, food-truck sizzle, footsteps), paper flutter, a rising airy breeze as the light grows.
Negative: no cuts or scene changes, no jump in time, no teleporting, reversing or tail-first airplane, no airplane shape change, no extra airplanes, no text, subtitles, watermarks or logos, no flicker, no change of location design, no music, no dirt field, no soccer match, no high aerial drone view before the stage, no jumping to another place, no close-up or recognisable faces, no raised hands or cheering, no airplane skimming the ground, no change of the festival layout, no air arch on the grass, no fireworks, no stage performance.
